name: carbon-docs
description: Author, edit, or extend the Carbon documentation site at `docs` (a built Fumadocs + Next.js app). Use whenever creating or changing reader-facing docs for Carbon: editorial Guide chapters, Reference/entity pages, the docs IA, or "document this feature" requests — anything destined for the docs site. Covers the grounded-in-source authoring workflow, the flow-based Guide architecture, the real MDX components for each surface, the warm-paper house style, and the build verification loop. Trigger even if the user doesn't say "docs" but clearly wants explanatory, reader-facing written material about how Carbon works.

findings.excerpt: curl -sS -X GET http://localhost:3002/docs/<slug> | grep -o "your new heading"   # confirm it rendered
awk '/<AgentContext>/{s=1} !s{print} /<\/AgentContext>/{s=0}' <page>.mdx | wc -w              # words vs the type's budget
